findings.claim: 第三方分析指 Carajás 至 Ponta da Madeira 港為單一約 900 公里鐵路，中斷即癱瘓最大鐵礦出口節點（非 Vale 官方說法）
findings.source: energy-solutions.co, Annual Production (Vale Brazil Iron Ore Carajás)
findings.excerpt: The rail line is a single 900-kilometer railway to the coastal port, and any disruption, whether from flooding, protests, or mechanical failure, instantly paralyzes the largest iron ore export node on the planet.

findings.claim: 2022 年 3 月 Carajás 鐵路因山崩停運；Vale 稱礦場與港口靠庫存管理照常運作，維持 320-335 Mt 指引
findings.source: Vale press release: temporary stoppage of Estrada de Ferro de Carajás railway operations

findings.claim: 中國占 Vale 鐵礦砂銷量比重 2021 至 2024 由 65% 降至 61%（聚合站報導，來源品質混雜）；另有報導 Oman 球團廠因中東衝突延後至 2026 Q3 重啟

note: Findings 2、3 未取得逐字原文；China 比重數字各來源不一致，未核 Vale 20-F。
